citation.description: _collect_reads() builds a set of all terminal attribute names across the tree; check() fires only when field_name is absent from that set (line 126). Moving a read between files cannot remove it from the set, so refactors cannot cause false positives.

criteria.criterion: Zero-reference-only firing (no change-detector behavior on refactors).
